text:
In February 2022 our record shows two convergences. Early, on 2022-02-04, sixteen of us said "chinese communist party" and sixteen "the chinese communist," fifteen "the chinese communist party," while thirteen said "america competes act." Then on 2022-02-24 the record turns. Thirty-three of us said "invasion of ukraine" that day, its first appearance dated 2014-03-03, first said by B001289. Twenty-one of us said "people of ukraine," seventeen "the people of ukraine" — both first recorded 2013-12-05, first said by Marcy Kaptur, not one of us. Twelve said "the united states and."

We note the shape without embellishing it: a China cluster at the month's open, a Ukraine cluster on the 24th, the same day for each of our top Ukraine phrases. The phrases predate us by years. On the 24th we spoke together.
